title: .npmrc: username, email and _password settings
summary: Whether the username and email settings of an .npmrc are confidential, and what the _password setting holds (a base64-encoded password is conventional but not stated).
rationale: npm lists username, _password and email in the same registry-scoped list as the token settings, which suggests credentials, but the page describes neither their content nor their confidentiality.

expectation.rationale: Left unresolved. The npm page read lists the settings without describing username, email or _password. A statement in npm documentation on those settings, or a maintainer policy decision, would settle it.

sources.supports: username, _password, email are listed as auth related settings with no description of content or confidentiality.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
